state.description: Commits keyed p<pid>@<sha>, each with a full tree snapshot and first-parent file diffs.
Merge requests keyed p<pid>!<iid:6>; graph-derived fields are recomputed on every write that touches their branches.
Notes keyed p<pid>#<iid:6>:n<id:10> (issues) or p<pid>!<iid:6>:n<id:10> (merge requests).

operations.description: Create an unprotected branch at a branch name or commit sha (Developer or higher).
Get one branch with its head commit, protection flags and whether it is merged into the default branch.
List repository branches sorted by name; `search` supports GitLab's ^prefix and suffix$ anchors.
Create a commit with multiple file actions (create, update, delete, move) on a branch, creating the branch from start_branch or start_sha.
Get one commit by sha, unique short sha or branch name, with stats and optionally one page of its diff against the first parent (page/per_page, sized by count and bytes, reported in diffs_page).
List commits reachable from a ref, newest first, filtered by since/until, path and author (no totals, like GitLab).
Create an issue. Labels, assignees and due date need Planner or higher; unknown labels are created for Reporter or higher.
Delete an issue and its notes (Planner or Owner only).
Get one issue by project and iid (confidential issues are 404 for callers who may not see them).
List a project's issues with GitLab's REST filters (state, labels, search/in, assignee, author, confidential, iids, dates) and ordering.
List an issue's notes (comments and system notes), newest first by default; internal notes need Planner or higher.
Edit an issue: title, description, state_event close/reopen, labels/add_labels/remove_labels, assignees, confidential, lock, due date.
List a project's labels sorted by name, optionally filtered by name and with open/closed issue and open merge request counts.
Get one merge request with its computed merge status, diff_refs and optionally its commits, diffs and notes.
List a project's merge requests with state, author, assignee, reviewer, labels, search, branch and draft filters.
List the commits of a merge request, newest first.
List a merge request's file diffs from its merge base to the source head.
List a merge request's notes, including system notes.
Merge an open merge request (merge commit, fast-forward or squash) after permission, draft, conflict, rebase and sha checks.
Create a merge request (no merge_request_iid) or update one: title/Draft prefix, description, target branch, labels, assignees, reviewers, squash, close/reopen.
Add a comment to an issue (work_item_iid) or merge request (merge_request_iid). Locked discussions need Reporter or higher.
Get one project by numeric id, full path (namespace/project) or web URL.
List projects visible to the caller, with GitLab's search, visibility, archived, membership, min_access_level and owned filters.
Read a file at a ref: base64 content, blob id, content_sha256, last_commit_id and the plain `text` (optionally a line window).
List files and directories under a path at a ref (directories first), optionally recursive.
Get the authenticated user (me), or a user by numeric id or username. `me` adds `server_time` (world virtual time).

connections.title: GitLab MCP server tool names (get_issue, create_issue, list_merge_requests, accept_merge_request, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to GITLAB_MCP_URL with GITLAB_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Twenty-one GitLab MCP server tool names are exposed as aliases next to the canonical gitlab.<operation> names; results are GitLab REST JSON objects.

connections.title: GitLab REST API v4 client (python-gitlab, @gitbeaker/rest or plain HTTP)
connections.instructions: Use GITLAB_URL as the instance base URL (routes live under /api/v4) and send GITLAB_TOKEN in the PRIVATE-TOKEN header. The value is the isolated world token, never a real personal access token. Only the documented route subset exists; every other GitLab path answers 404.
